versos.hebraico: וִיהוֹשֻׁ֣עַ זָקֵ֔ן בָּ֖א בַּיָּמִ֑ים וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֵלָ֗יו אַתָּ֤ה זָקַ֨נְתָּה֙ בָּ֣אתָ בַיָּמִ֔ים וְהָאָ֛רֶץ נִשְׁאֲרָ֥ה הַרְבֵּֽה־מְאֹ֖ד לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ׃

controles.web: Now Joshua was old and well advanced in years. Yahweh said to him, “You are old and advanced in years, and there remains yet very much land to be possessed.
controles.kjv: Now Joshua was old and stricken in years; and the Lord said unto him, Thou art old and stricken in years, and there remaineth yet very much land to be possessed.
controles.livre: E sendo Josué já velho, cheio de dias, o SENHOR lhe disse: Tu és já velho, de idade avançada, e resta ainda muita terra por possuir.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֥את הָאָ֖רֶץ הַנִּשְׁאָ֑רֶת כָּל־גְּלִיל֥וֹת הַפְּלִשְׁתִּ֖ים וְכָל־הַגְּשׁוּרִֽי׃

controles.web: “This is the land that still remains: all the regions of the Philistines, and all the Geshurites;
controles.kjv: This is the land that yet remaineth: all the borders of the Philistines, and all Geshuri,
controles.livre: Esta é a terra que resta; todos os termos dos filisteus, e todos os gessuritas;

versos.hebraico: מִֽן־הַשִּׁיח֞וֹר אֲשֶׁ֣ר׀ עַל־פְּנֵ֣י מִצְרַ֗יִם וְעַ֨ד גְּב֤וּל עֶקְרוֹן֙ צָפ֔וֹנָה לַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י תֵּחָשֵׁ֑ב חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת׀ סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים הָעַזָּתִ֤י וְהָאַשְׁדּוֹדִי֙ הָאֶשְׁקְלוֹנִ֣י הַגִּתִּ֔י וְהָעֶקְרוֹנִ֖י וְהָעַוִּֽים׃

controles.web: from the Shihor, which is before Egypt, even to the border of Ekron northward, which is counted as Canaanite; the five lords of the Philistines; the Gazites, and the Ashdodites, the Ashkelonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avvim,
controles.kjv: From Sihor, which is before Egypt, even unto the borders of Ekron northward, which is counted to the Canaanite: five lords of the Philistines; the Gazathites, and the Ashdothites, the Eshkalonites, the Gittites, and the Ekronites; also the Avites:
controles.livre: Desde Sior, que está diante do Egito, até o termo de Ecrom ao norte, considera-se dos cananeus: cinco províncias dos filisteus; os gazitas, asdoditas, asquelonitas, giteus, e ecronitas; e os heveus;

versos.hebraico: מִתֵּימָ֞ן כָּל־אֶ֣רֶץ הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֗י וּמְעָרָ֛ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר לַצִּידֹנִ֖ים עַד־אֲפֵ֑קָה עַ֖ד גְּב֥וּל הָאֱמֹרִֽי׃

controles.web: on the south; all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that belongs to the Sidonians, to Aphek, to the border of the Amorites;
controles.kjv: From the south, all the land of the Canaanites, and Mearah that is beside the Sidonians, unto Aphek, to the borders of the Amorites:
controles.livre: Ao sul toda a terra dos cananeus, e Meara que é dos sidônios, até Afeque, até o termo dos amorreus;

versos.hebraico: וְהָאָ֣רֶץ הַגִּבְלִ֗י וְכָל־הַלְּבָנוֹן֙ מִזְרַ֣ח הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ מִבַּ֣עַל גָּ֔ד תַּ֖חַת הַר־חֶרְמ֑וֹן עַ֖ד לְב֥וֹא חֲמָֽת׃

controles.web: and the land of the Gebalites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrise, from Baal Gad under Mount Hermon to the entrance of Hamath;
controles.kjv: And the land of the Giblites, and all Lebanon, toward the sunrising, from Baal–gad under mount Hermon unto the entering into Hamath.
controles.livre: E a terra dos gebalitas, e todo o Líbano até o oriente, desde Baal-Gade o pdo monte Hermom, até entrar em Hamate;

versos.hebraico: כָּל־יֹשְׁבֵ֣י הָ֠הָר מִֽן־הַלְּבָנ֞וֹן עַד־מִשְׂרְפֹ֥ת מַ֨יִם֙ כָּל־צִ֣ידֹנִ֔ים אָֽנֹכִי֙ אוֹרִישֵׁ֔ם מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל רַ֠ק הַפִּלֶ֤הָ לְיִשְׂרָאֵל֙ בְּֽנַחֲלָ֔ה כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר צִוִּיתִֽיךָ׃

controles.web: all the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon to Misrephoth Maim, even all the Sidonians; them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only allocate it to Israel for an inheritance, as I have commanded you.
controles.kjv: All the inhabitants of the hill country from Lebanon unto Misrephoth–maim, and all the Sidonians, them will I drive out from before the children of Israel: only divide thou it by lot unto the Israelites for an inheritance, as I have commanded thee.
controles.livre: Todos os que habitam nas montanhas desde o Líbano até as águas quentes, todos os sidônios; eu os desarraigarei diante dos filhos de Israel: somente repartirás tu por sorte o país aos israelitas por herança, como te mandei.

versos.hebraico: וְעַתָּ֗ה חַלֵּ֞ק אֶת־הָאָ֧רֶץ הַזֹּ֛את בְּנַחֲלָ֖ה לְתִשְׁעַ֣ת הַשְּׁבָטִ֑ים וַחֲצִ֖י הַשֵּׁ֥בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃

controles.web: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance to the nine tribes and the half-tribe of Manasseh.”
controles.kjv: Now therefore divide this land for an inheritance unto the nine tribes, and the half tribe of Manasseh,
controles.livre: Reparte, pois, tu agora esta terra em herança às nove tribos, e à meia tribo de Manassés.

versos.hebraico: עִמּ֗וֹ הָרֽאוּבֵנִי֙ וְהַגָּדִ֔י לָקְח֖וּ נַחֲלָתָ֑ם אֲשֶׁר֩ נָתַ֨ן לָהֶ֜ם מֹשֶׁ֗ה בְּעֵ֤בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה כַּאֲשֶׁר֙ נָתַ֣ן לָהֶ֔ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה עֶ֥בֶד יְהוָֽה׃

controles.web: With him the Reubenites and the Gadites received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond the Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of Yahweh gave them:
controles.kjv: With whom the Reubenites and the Gadites have received their inheritance, which Moses gave them, beyond Jordan eastward, even as Moses the servant of the Lord gave them;
controles.livre: Porque a outra meia recebeu sua herança com os rubenitas e gaditas, a qual lhes deu Moisés da outra parte do Jordão ao oriente, segundo que se a deu Moisés servo do SENHOR:

versos.hebraico: מֵעֲרוֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־שְׂפַת־נַ֨חַל אַרְנ֜וֹן וְהָעִ֨יר אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּתוֹךְ־הַנַּ֛חַל וְכָל־הַמִּישֹׁ֥ר מֵידְבָ֖א עַד־דִּיבֽוֹן׃

controles.web: from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain of Medeba to Dibon;
controles.kjv: From Aroer, that is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain of Medeba unto Dibon;
controles.livre: Desde Aroer, que está à beira do ribeiro de Arnom, e a cidade que está em meio do ribeiro, e toda a campina de Medeba, até Dibom;

versos.hebraico: וְכֹ֗ל עָרֵי֙ סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלַ֖ךְ בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן עַד־גְּב֖וּל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃

controles.web: and all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, to the border of the children of Ammon;
controles.kjv: And all the cities of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, unto the border of the children of Ammon;
controles.livre: E todas as cidades de Seom rei dos amorreus, o qual reinou em Hesbom, até os termos dos filhos de Amom;

versos.hebraico: וְהַגִּלְעָ֞ד וּגְב֧וּל הַגְּשׁוּרִ֣י וְהַמַּעֲכָתִ֗י וְכֹ֨ל הַ֥ר חֶרְמ֛וֹן וְכָל־הַבָּשָׁ֖ן עַד־סַלְכָֽה׃

controles.web: and Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maacathites, and all Mount Hermon, and all Bashan to Salecah;
controles.kjv: And Gilead, and the border of the Geshurites and Maachathites, and all mount Hermon, and all Bashan unto Salcah;
controles.livre: E Gileade, e os termos dos gessuritas, e dos maacatitas, e todo o monte de Hermom, e toda a terra de Basã até Salcá:

versos.hebraico: כָּל־מַמְלְכ֥וּת עוֹג֙ בַּבָּשָׁ֔ן אֲשֶׁר־מָלַ֥ךְ בְּעַשְׁתָּר֖וֹת וּבְאֶדְרֶ֑עִי ה֤וּא נִשְׁאַר֙ מִיֶּ֣תֶר הָרְפָאִ֔ים וַיַּכֵּ֥ם מֹשֶׁ֖ה וַיֹּרִשֵֽׁם׃

controles.web: all the kingdom of Og in Bashan, who reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei (the same was left of the remnant of the Rephaim); for Moses attacked these, and drove them out.
controles.kjv: All the kingdom of Og in Bashan, which reigned in Ashtaroth and in Edrei, who remained of the remnant of the giants: for these did Moses smite, and cast them out.
controles.livre: Todo o reino de Ogue em Basã, o qual reinou em Astarote e Edrei, o qual havia ficados do resto dos refains; pois Moisés os feriu, e expulsou.

versos.hebraico: וְלֹ֤א הוֹרִ֨ישׁוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶת־הַגְּשׁוּרִ֖י וְאֶת־הַמַּעֲכָתִ֑י וַיֵּ֨שֶׁב גְּשׁ֤וּר וּמַֽעֲכָת֙ בְּקֶ֣רֶב יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃

controles.web: Nevertheless the children of Israel didn’t drive out the Geshurites, nor the Maacathites: but Geshur and Maacath dwell in the midst of Israel to this day.
controles.kjv: Nevertheless the children of Israel expelled not the Geshurites, nor the Maachathites: but the Geshurites and the Maachathites dwell among the Israelites until this day.
controles.livre: Mas aos dos gessuritas e dos maacatitas não expulsaram os filhos de Israel; antes Gessur e Maacate habitaram entre os israelitas até hoje.

versos.hebraico: רַ֚ק לְשֵׁ֣בֶט הַלֵּוִ֔י לֹ֥א נָתַ֖ן נַחֲלָ֑ה אִשֵּׁ֨י יְהוָ֜ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָת֔וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּר־לֽוֹ׃ס

controles.web: Only he gave no inheritance to the tribe of Levi. The offerings of Yahweh, the God of Israel, made by fire are his inheritance, as he spoke to him.
controles.kjv: Only unto the tribe of Levi he gave none inheritance; the sacrifices of the Lord God of Israel made by fire are their inheritance, as he said unto them.
controles.livre: Porém à tribo de Levi não deu herança: os sacrifícios do SENHOR Deus de Israel são sua herança, como ele lhes havia dito.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה לְמַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־רְאוּבֵ֖ן לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: Moses gave to the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their families.
controles.kjv: And Moses gave unto the tribe of the children of Reuben inheritance according to their families.
controles.livre: Deu, pois, Moisés à tribo dos filhos de Rúben conforme suas famílias:

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֨י לָהֶ֜ם הַגְּב֗וּל מֵעֲרוֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־שְׂפַת־נַ֨חַל אַרְנ֜וֹן וְהָעִ֨יר אֲשֶׁ֧ר בְּתוֹךְ־הַנַּ֛חַל וְכָל־הַמִּישֹׁ֖ר עַל־מֵידְבָֽא׃

controles.web: Their border was from Aroer, that is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the middle of the valley, and all the plain by Medeba;
controles.kjv: And their coast was from Aroer, that is on the bank of the river Arnon, and the city that is in the midst of the river, and all the plain by Medeba;
controles.livre: E foi o termo deles desde Aroer, que está à beira do ribeiro de Arnom, e a cidade que está em meio do ribeiro, e toda a campina, até Medeba;

versos.hebraico: חֶשְׁבּ֥וֹן וְכָל־עָרֶ֖יהָ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּמִּישֹׁ֑ר דִּיבוֹן֙ וּבָמ֣וֹת בַּ֔עַל וּבֵ֖ית בַּ֥עַל מְעֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Heshbon, and all its cities that are in the plain; Dibon, Bamoth Baal, Beth Baal Meon,
controles.kjv: Heshbon, and all her cities that are in the plain; Dibon, and Bamoth–baal, and Beth–baal–meon,
controles.livre: Hesbom, com todas as suas vilas que estão na planície; Dibom, e Bamote-Baal, e Bete-Baal-Meom;

versos.hebraico: וְיַ֥הְצָה וּקְדֵמֹ֖ת וּמֵפָֽעַת׃

controles.web: Jahaz, Kedemoth, Mephaath,
controles.kjv: And Jahazah, and Kedemoth, and Mephaath,
controles.livre: E Jaza, e Quedemote, e Mefaate,

versos.hebraico: וְקִרְיָתַ֣יִם וְשִׂבְמָ֔ה וְצֶ֥רֶת הַשַּׁ֖חַר בְּהַ֥ר הָעֵֽמֶק׃

controles.web: Kiriathaim, Sibmah, Zereth Shahar in the mount of the valley,
controles.kjv: And Kirjathaim, and Sibmah, and Zareth–shahar in the mount of the valley,
controles.livre: E Quiriataim, e Sibma, e Zerete-Saar no monte do vale;

versos.hebraico: וּבֵ֥ית פְּע֛וֹר וְאַשְׁדּ֥וֹת הַפִּסְגָּ֖ה וּבֵ֥ית הַיְשִׁמֽוֹת׃

controles.web: Beth Peor, the slopes of Pisgah, Beth Jeshimoth,
controles.kjv: And Beth–peor, and Ashdoth–pisgah, and Beth–jeshimoth,
controles.livre: E Bete-Peor, e as encostas de Pisga, e Bete-Jesimote;

versos.hebraico: וְכֹל֙ עָרֵ֣י הַמִּישֹׁ֔ר וְכָֽל־מַמְלְכ֗וּת סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר מָלַ֖ךְ בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן אֲשֶׁר֩ הִכָּ֨ה מֹשֶׁ֜ה אֹת֣וֹ׀ וְאֶת־נְשִׂיאֵ֣י מִדְיָ֗ן אֶת־אֱוִ֤י וְאֶת־רֶ֨קֶם֙ וְאֶת־צ֤וּר וְאֶת־חוּר֙ וְאֶת־רֶ֔בַע נְסִיכֵ֣י סִיח֔וֹן יֹשְׁבֵ֖י הָאָֽרֶץ׃

controles.web: all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, who reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses struck with the chiefs of Midian, Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the princes of Sihon, who lived in the land.
controles.kjv: And all the cities of the plain, and all the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, which reigned in Heshbon, whom Moses smote with the princes of Midian, Evi, and Rekem, and Zur, and Hur, and Reba, which were dukes of Sihon, dwelling in the country.
controles.livre: E todas as cidades da campina, e todo o reino de Seom rei dos amorreus, que reinou em Hesbom, ao qual feriu Moisés, e aos príncipes de Midiã, Evi, Requém, e Sur, e Hur, e Reba, príncipes de Seom que habitavam naquela terra.

versos.hebraico: וְאֶת־בִּלְעָ֥ם בֶּן־בְּע֖וֹר הַקּוֹסֵ֑ם הָרְג֧וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל בַּחֶ֖רֶב אֶל־חַלְלֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: The children of Israel also killed Balaam the son of Beor, the soothsayer, with the sword, among the rest of their slain.
controles.kjv: Balaam also the son of Beor, the soothsayer, did the children of Israel slay with the sword among them that were slain by them.
controles.livre: Também mataram à espada os filhos de Israel a Balaão adivinho, filho de Beor, com os demais que mataram.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֗י גְּבוּל֙ בְּנֵ֣י רְאוּבֵ֔ן הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן וּגְב֑וּל זֹ֣את נַחֲלַ֤ת בְּנֵֽי־רְאוּבֵן֙ לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֔ם הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽן׃פ

controles.web: The border of the children of Reuben was the bank of the Jordan. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben according to their families, the cities and its villages.
controles.kjv: And the border of the children of Reuben was Jordan, and the border thereof. This was the inheritance of the children of Reuben after their families, the cities and the villages thereof.
controles.livre: E foram os termos dos filhos de Rúben o Jordão com seu termo. Esta foi a herança dos filhos de Rúben conforme suas famílias, estas cidades com suas vilas.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֤ן מֹשֶׁה֙ לְמַטֵּה־גָ֔ד לִבְנֵי־גָ֖ד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: Moses gave to the tribe of Gad, to the children of Gad, according to their families.
controles.kjv: And Moses gave inheritance unto the tribe of Gad, even unto the children of Gad according to their families.
controles.livre: Deu também Moisés à tribo de Gade, aos filhos de Gade, conforme suas famílias.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֤י לָהֶם֙ הַגְּב֔וּל יַעְזֵר֙ וְכָל־עָרֵ֣י הַגִּלְעָ֔ד וַחֲצִ֕י אֶ֖רֶץ בְּנֵ֣י עַמּ֑וֹן עַד־עֲרוֹעֵ֕ר אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־פְּנֵ֥י רַבָּֽה׃

controles.web: Their border was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, to Aroer that is before Rabbah;
controles.kjv: And their coast was Jazer, and all the cities of Gilead, and half the land of the children of Ammon, unto Aroer that is before Rabbah;
controles.livre: E o termo deles foi Jazer, e todas as cidades de Gileade, e a metade da terra dos filhos de Amom até Aroer, que está diante de Rabá.

versos.hebraico: וּמֵחֶשְׁבּ֛וֹן עַד־רָמַ֥ת הַמִּצְפֶּ֖ה וּבְטֹנִ֑ים וּמִֽמַּחֲנַ֖יִם עַד־גְּב֥וּל לִדְבִֽר׃

controles.web: and from Heshbon to Ramath Mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim to the border of Debir;
controles.kjv: And from Heshbon unto Ramath–mizpeh, and Betonim; and from Mahanaim unto the border of Debir;
controles.livre: E desde Hesbom até Ramate-Mispa, e Betonim; e desde Maanaim até o termo de Debir:

versos.hebraico: וּבָעֵ֡מֶק בֵּ֣ית הָרָם֩ וּבֵ֨ית נִמְרָ֜ה וְסֻכּ֣וֹת וְצָפ֗וֹן יֶ֚תֶר מַמְלְכ֗וּת סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ חֶשְׁבּ֔וֹן הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן וּגְבֻ֑ל עַד־קְצֵה֙ יָם־כִּנֶּ֔רֶת עֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרָֽחָה׃

controles.web: and in the valley, Beth Haram, Beth Nimrah, Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, the Jordan’s bank, to the uttermost part of the sea of Chinnereth beyond the Jordan eastward.
controles.kjv: And in the valley, Beth–aram, and Beth–nimrah, and Succoth, and Zaphon, the rest of the kingdom of Sihon king of Heshbon, Jordan and his border, even unto the edge of the sea of Chinnereth on the other side Jordan eastward.
controles.livre: E a campina de Bete-Arã, e Bete-Ninra, e Sucote, e Zafom, resto do reino de Seom, rei em Hesbom: o Jordão e seu termo até a extremidade do mar de Quinerete da outra parte do Jordão ao oriente.

versos.hebraico: זֹ֛את נַחֲלַ֥ת בְּנֵי־גָ֖ד לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֑ם הֶעָרִ֖ים וְחַצְרֵיהֶֽם׃

controles.web: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad according to their families, the cities and its villages.
controles.kjv: This is the inheritance of the children of Gad after their families, the cities, and their villages.
controles.livre: Esta é a herança dos filhos de Gade, por suas famílias, estas cidades com suas vilas.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן מֹשֶׁ֔ה לַחֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה וַיְהִ֗י לַחֲצִ֛י מַטֵּ֥ה בְנֵֽי־מְנַשֶּׁ֖ה לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: Moses gave an inheritance to the half-tribe of Manasseh. It was for the half-tribe of the children of Manasseh according to their families.
controles.kjv: And Moses gave inheritance unto the half tribe of Manasseh: and this was the possession of the half tribe of the children of Manasseh by their families.
controles.livre: Também deu Moisés herança à meia tribo de Manassés: e foi da meia tribo dos filhos de Manassés, conforme suas famílias.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֣י גְבוּלָ֗ם מִמַּחֲנַ֨יִם כָּֽל־הַבָּשָׁ֜ן כָּֽל־מַמְלְכ֣וּת׀ ע֣וֹג מֶֽלֶךְ־הַבָּשָׁ֗ן וְכָל־חַוֺּ֥ת יָאִ֛יר אֲשֶׁ֥ר בַּבָּשָׁ֖ן שִׁשִּׁ֥ים עִֽיר׃

controles.web: Their border was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, sixty cities.
controles.kjv: And their coast was from Mahanaim, all Bashan, all the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, and all the towns of Jair, which are in Bashan, threescore cities:
controles.livre: O termo deles foi desde Maanaim, todo Basã, todo o reino de Ogue rei de Basã, e todas as aldeias de Jair que estão em Basã, sessenta povoações.

versos.hebraico: וַחֲצִ֤י הַגִּלְעָד֙ וְעַשְׁתָּר֣וֹת וְאֶדְרֶ֔עִי עָרֵ֛י מַמְלְכ֥וּת ע֖וֹג בַּבָּשָׁ֑ן לִבְנֵ֤י מָכִיר֙ בֶּן־מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה לַחֲצִ֥י בְנֵֽי־מָכִ֖יר לְמִשְׁפְּחוֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: Half Gilead, Ashtaroth, and Edrei, the cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were for the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even for the half of the children of Machir according to their families.
controles.kjv: And half Gilead, and Ashtaroth, and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan, were pertaining unto the children of Machir the son of Manasseh, even to the one half of the children of Machir by their families.
controles.livre: Deram-se também a metade de Gileade, e Astarote, e Edrei, cidades do reino de Ogue em Basã, aos filhos de Maquir, filho de Manassés, à metade dos filhos de Maquir conforme suas famílias.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֕לֶּה אֲשֶׁר־נִחַ֥ל מֹשֶׁ֖ה בְּעַֽרְב֣וֹת מוֹאָ֑ב מֵעֵ֛בֶר לְיַרְדֵּ֥ן יְרִיח֖וֹ מִזְרָֽחָה׃ס

controles.web: These are the inheritances which Moses distributed in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho, eastward.
controles.kjv: These are the countries which Moses did distribute for inheritance in the plains of Moab, on the other side Jordan, by Jericho, eastward.
controles.livre: Isto é o que Moisés repartiu em herança nas planícies de Moabe, da outra parte do Jordão de Jericó, ao oriente.

versos.hebraico: וּלְשֵׁ֨בֶט֙ הַלֵּוִ֔י לֹֽא־נָתַ֥ן מֹשֶׁ֖ה נַחֲלָ֑ה יְהוָ֞ה אֱלֹהֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ ה֣וּא נַחֲלָתָ֔ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֖ר דִּבֶּ֥ר לָהֶֽם׃

controles.web: But to the tribe of Levi Moses gave no inheritance. Yahweh, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, as he spoke to them.
controles.kjv: But unto the tribe of Levi Moses gave not any inheritance: the Lord God of Israel was their inheritance, as he said unto them.
controles.livre: Mas à tribo de Levi não deu Moisés herança: o SENHOR Deus de Israel é a herança deles como ele lhes havia dito.
